landing.problemSubtitle: Eight practical barriers that keep families in smaller towns and villages from timely medical attention.

challenges.title: Long travel distances
challenges.desc: Villagers often travel 20–50 km to reach district clinics for routine consultations.

challenges.title: Limited doctor availability
challenges.desc: Many rural primary centres face shortages of physicians and rotating schedules.

challenges.title: High travel and wage loss
challenges.desc: Daily-wage earners lose a full day of income alongside transport and clinic fees.

challenges.title: Specialist access gap
challenges.desc: Reaching pediatricians or gynecologists requires costly referrals to urban hospitals.

challenges.title: Unverified health advice
challenges.desc: Families lack reliable, medically reviewed information for preventive care.

challenges.title: Language barriers
challenges.desc: Medical portals built only in English exclude Telugu and Hindi speaking households.

challenges.title: Mobility hurdles for elders
challenges.desc: Elderly and low-income patients struggle with physical queues and repeat follow-ups.

challenges.title: Low-bandwidth realities
challenges.desc: Heavy interfaces fail on intermittent 3G/4G connections common in rural mandals.

landing.solutionSubtitle: Affordable ₹100 consultations, role-protected health records, and multilingual guidance built for low-bandwidth access.
solutionPoints: Duplicate-protected slot booking with transaction safety
Authorized doctor-patient consultation room via WebRTC signaling
OpenStreetMap hospital discovery with manual village search fallback

steps.detail: Select English, Telugu, or Hindi and create your village profile in under a minute.
Filter verified doctors by language, specialization, and available dates.
Complete simulated or configured gateway payment to lock your time slot.
Consult online from home and review doctor notes or locate nearby hospitals.

faqs.q: How much does an online doctor consultation cost?
faqs.a: The proposed consultation fee is ₹100 per session, with a ₹35 direct operating cost model designed for rural affordability. During development, payments run in a clearly labelled simulation mode unless Razorpay credentials are configured.

faqs.q: Are the doctors shown on the platform real?
faqs.a: Initial demonstration doctors and hospitals in the directory are clearly labelled as Sample Demo Profiles. Newly registered doctors receive verified status only after an administrator reviews and approves their credentials.

faqs.q: Can elderly patients use the platform in Telugu or Hindi?
faqs.a: Yes. Switching between English, తెలుగు, and हिन्दी immediately translates navigation, dashboards, forms, and educational health articles, and saves your preference to your profile.

faqs.q: What happens if I need in-person hospital care?
faqs.a: Use the Nearby Hospital Finder powered by OpenStreetMap and Leaflet to search clinics by village or mandal, view available facilities, and open step-by-step directions.
